subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: While a record's gate verdict is ready-for-prd, every decision-shaped input `prd-new`'s template requires (problem, segments, jobs, goals direction, non-goals, appetite) shall hold a resolved decision, and every fog entry remaining in the record shall be typed non-blocking — sufficient for synthesis to proceed with no new operator decision-questions, remaining fog landing as the draft's open questions.
rationale: the handoff is the product's success condition (M1); sufficiency must be checkable, not hoped — ready-for-prd with a gap in a decision-shaped input is a contradiction (FR-11)
fit_criterion: `prd-new` run against every ready-for-prd fixture record asks median 0 (max ≤ 2) operator decision-questions (EVAL-5); the record-to-template coverage checklist reports full decision coverage of decision-shaped inputs and zero blocking fog
